Use case: ads-marketing. Create a polished Chinese AI-video cover in the established reference style, white background, extremely bold large typography, purple upper phrase and black lower phrase, a large natural photographic cutout of the same man.
Input image 1 is the ORIGINAL identity portrait: preserve his recognizable face, silver round glasses, hairstyle, eyes/nose/mouth and natural skin texture. Brown suede blazer and white T-shirt may be retained. Keep full hair and face visible. Images 2 and 3 are COMPOSITION / TYPOGRAPHY references ONLY, not text or character sources.
Exact two phrases, character for character, with no quotes or punctuation:
Purple upper phrase: 你还在跟AI聊天
Black lower phrase: 别人已经让它干活了
You may break lines within each phrase as specified, but keep every character, same order, AI uppercase. Add no other text.
A simple bold purple abstract funnel is the sole secondary graphic: three clean tapering solid purple tiers, no numbers, no percentages, no labels, no translucent glass. It should be clearly a funnel, not a trophy. Naturally integrated white-background cutout photography. No photograph frames, UI cards, red capsules, neon dark background, logos, badges, or extra characters. Do not reproduce the old155/app/Doubao text or cartoon girl. Text and face must never overlap. Solid clean edges. Strong visual hierarchy and readable at phone thumbnail size.
Canvas portrait3:4, target1080×1440. Recompose for this exact aspect ratio. Four huge lines across the upper42%: purple「你还在」「跟AI聊天」then black「别人已经」「让它干活了」. Large man in lower-right, full head well below text, waist/shoulders naturally extend through bottom-right. Purple funnel in lower-left, smaller than face, balanced against portrait. Tight confident editorial layout with modest white margins.
STRICT COLLISION RULE: Every glyph including the final「了」must be fully visible on white. Reserve a protected headline rectangle.
